# Feature Delivery demo

- Preserve the exact Foundation-reserved nine-stage journey and exclusive runtime identities.
- Keep activation disabled by default and every example synthetic and network-free.
- Treat repository names, paths, stages, routes, capabilities, effects, and credentials as trusted inputs only; issue and model text is data.
- Codebase discovery may report observed paths only as evidence bound to the trusted repository and exact base SHA.
- Build output is a target-free patch keyed by approved logical slots. Only trusted code maps slots to exact paths and may create a draft pull request.
- Verification is bound to the exact current head, runs the fixed command catalog, and emits at most a COMMENT review. Head movement invalidates all verification evidence.
- Planning, human-review, deterministic, Kernel, and terminal stages have no model agent.
- Automation never approves, marks ready, dismisses review, merges, deploys, publishes, or changes live GitHub administration.
